content.title: 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four - Lucas Oil Stadium
content.text: 2026 NCAA Men’s Final Four – April 4 & 6 The 2026 NCAA Men’s Final Four will be the fourth time the stadium has hosted the Men’s Final Four (2010, 2015, 2021). Prior to Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis hosted the Men’s Final Four in 1980 at Market Square Arena and 1991, 1997, 2000, and 2006 at the RCA Dome. For KNOW BEFORE YOU GO and more information on all events surrounding the 2026 NCAA Final Four, click HERE. Ticket & Hospitality Packages: Experience the thrills of the Men’s Final Four. Feel the thrill as On Location brings you exclusive access with official ticket and hospitality packages. Packages include All-Session game tickets bundled with unrivaled hospitality. From an open an open bar and wine bar, deluxe food stations, and appearances by NCAA legends, it’s more than just a game – it’s a front-row seat to experiencing NCAA history in the making! Visit NCAA.com/VIP & Buy Now! Exclusive Luxury Suite Experience: For an unparalleled game day, elevate your NCAA experience with a limited availability Luxury Suite. Enjoy personalized service and a private, comfortable atmosphere in the heart of the action. Visit NCAA.com/VIP to learn more! To stay up to date on all the latest information, sign up HERE. Please note that everyone, regardless of age, must have a ticket for the NCAA Men’s Final Four. For NCAA General Ticketing FAQs, click HERE.
